label: PL-2000M 200G muxponder
description: 1RU 200G multi-protocol muxponder: up to 20 multi-rate client interfaces (10GbE, 40GbE, 100GbE, 8G/16G/32G Fibre Channel, 12G-SDI, OC-192, OTU2/OTU2e/OTU3/OTU4) aggregated onto one coherent 200G CFP2 uplink. Modelled as 2x 100G QSFP28 client ports + 16x 10G SFP+ client ports plus the single 200G line port, modelled at this engine's 100G ceiling.
